audit_items.proof_trace: The Discord server membership check (`fetchMemberStatus` → `is_in_server`) is entirely commented out (L106-119, labeled '一時的にコメントアウト'). The only remaining gate is a `member.members` table lookup by `discord_uid` (L123-143), which confirms prior registration but does NOT verify current Discord server membership. The property therefore does not hold: `oauth_callback_success(user)` never implies `discord_membership_verified(user) == true`.
audit_items.attack_scenario: A user previously registered in the system but subsequently removed from the Discord server can complete Discord OAuth, pass the `member.members` lookup (their row still exists), and gain full authenticated access — the server membership check is dead code.
